consumption_note: Core/default pack payload (issue #71, Phase A2): the domain-neutral baseline setup_config. It declares only core defaults — gate/ER threshold declarations, the neutral proposer/slot framing, and the D5 enumeration window default. It declares no schema, inventory, label category, merge prohibition, fitted artefact, model name, endpoint, or secret: domain content arrives only when a specified domain pack overrides these keys per key (pipeline.profile_config.resolve_setup_config). Model bindings live in the connection layer's reference profile (D9 / R14), never in this payload.
pair_judge_note: F1 fitted pair-judge configuration (sentence context x standard instruction; docs/REDOCRED_JF_F1_DESIGN.md). The JF-F1 direction slot is a core mechanism adopted by that measurement (eta 0.1124 -> 0.2596; flips 131 -> 7; candidate precision 0.3464 -> 0.8381); this baseline deliberately does not activate it — activation is a domain pack's declaration (pair_judge_format 'jf1' + its pinned pair_judge_symmetric_source artefact), because the symmetric set is inventory data the core pack does not own. Fail-closed: 'jf1' without the source does not validate.
pair_window_note: D5 (2026-10-21): shipped enumeration operating point = max_dist=1 + REC. 'adjacent' is the setup_config spelling of max_dist=1; it takes effect when a run or pack selects pair enumeration — this baseline does not force pair_enumeration on (packs that omit the switch keep the core free-proposal path, and a pack declaring its own pair_window overrides this default). REC (deterministic roster surface recovery, docs/REDOCRED_ENUMERATION_DESIGN.md §3) is core mechanism with no setup_config key. Measured basis (500-document Re-DocRED corpus): 52,463 candidate pairs, projected judging $35.06, estimated ceiling-adjusted recall 0.1884 — vs sentence-only 26,938 pairs at ≈$18.68 realized ledger, estimated recall 0.1346.
proposer_framing: Extract factual relations from the excerpt below.
slot_framing: You extract clause facts from the excerpt below.
slot_rules:
- "value": the shortest complete value, as written in the
  excerpt. For dates, as written.
- "quote": copy the EXACT verbatim text from the excerpt that states
  the fact (a phrase or one sentence). It must match the excerpt
  character-for-character. Never paraphrase the quote.
